lines: A hot spring inn on the outskirts of town.
Reproduced Saya
Haa. The water is so nice~♪ It feels like all the fatigue from the day just blows away. You feel the same way, don't you, Fuuma-kun?
Reproduced Saya, sitting next to me, let out a comfortable-sounding voice.
After rinsing off lightly, I was finally soaking in the bath, taking my time to relax.
Me
Eh, yes. It really is the best...
Me
This hot spring is apparently a famous one with various benefits, like recovering from fatigue, joint pain, stiff shoulders, and cold hands and feet!
Me
Especially after moving around during the day like today, it really works, right!
Reproduced Saya
Yeah, it was hot today, and I was sweating buckets while overseeing the investigation.
Me
Right, that was quite a ordeal. I thought I was going to dry out!
Reproduced Saya
Yeah. Well, that's all well and good, but by the way, Fuuma-kun?
Reproduced Saya
Why have you been so stubborn about not looking at me? Are you getting shy, maybe?
Me
Tch!!
I flinched when she said that.
I was sitting next to her at her invitation, but
to be polite, I had been keeping my gaze fixed straight ahead.
Me
Um... you noticed?
Reproduced Saya
Aha! Well, you were acting pretty suspicious, weren't you?
Me
I... I see...
I thought I was acting perfectly normal, but it seems Reproduced Saya saw right through me.
Me
Well, I am a little shy. Even though we're in swimsuits, we're still bathing together with a girl.
Me
Besides, weren't you shy just a moment ago too?
Reproduced Saya
Eh? Well, just a little... Hey, drop it! It's not about me!
Me
Ah. Yes, I'm sorry!
When I apologized, Reproduced Saya let out a small, amused laugh.
Reproduced Saya
It's been a while... this kind of 'normal' feeling...
Me
Reproduced Saya
Ah, no... joking around like this, having casual conversations...
Reproduced Saya
Of course, I did relax and goof around with everyone over there too, but...
Reproduced Saya
But deep down, there was always that fear of not knowing when 'them' would come.
Reproduced Saya
But in this world, at least, that worry is gone, right?
Reproduced Saya
So... I guess I just let my guard down...
Me
I see...
Reproduced Saya said that, letting out a deep breath while soaking in the hot water.
I could understand how she felt.
In a world where civilization had collapsed, she had been constantly exposed to life-or-death situations.
The tension she had felt every day must have been overwhelming.
Reproduced Saya
So, just being able to feel this way is enough. I'm glad I asked you to escort me. ...Thank you, Fuuma-kun.
Me
No, it's nothing... I don't deserve praise for that...
Me
But, Reproduced Saya. Why do you want to go back to such a dangerous world?
It seemed that Saeko and the others had loved ones in that world and strongly wished to return to them.
Was Reproduced Saya the same?
Reproduced Saya
Ah... I don't know? I guess I'm in a similar situation to those two.
Reproduced Saya
But the reason I want to go back is because I can't leave the comrades I've survived with all this time.
Reproduced Saya
And also, because I want to see my mom and dad again...
Me
Your parents...?
Reproduced Saya looked at my face and smiled gently.
Reproduced Saya
Yes, the truth is, I don't know if they're still alive.
Reproduced Saya
They risked their lives to help me and my comrades escape from 'them'.
Reproduced Saya
The last time I saw my mom and dad, they were surrounded by 'them'.
Reproduced Saya
So I think there's almost no hope... but I don't want to give up.
Me
They must have been wonderful parents.
When I said that, Reproduced Saya shrugged slightly and gave a wry smile.
Reproduced Saya
Heh, I don't know? They were extremely extreme people, after all...
Reproduced Saya
They weren't exactly seen as simple good people by society, either.
Reproduced Saya
But they stuck to their beliefs until the end and did what needed to be done.
Reproduced Saya
They protected those who looked up to them, and gave their lives for us...
Reproduced Saya
I feel proud of those people... and I want to live in the same way.
Me
Could that be why you volunteered to join today's investigation?
Reproduced Saya had volunteered to participate in the investigation regarding the "Gate to Another World" and the disappearance of the zombies.
She said that if there was even a slight possibility, she wanted to do what she was supposed to do.
Perhaps that behavior was the influence of her parents, who had risked their lives to protect her.
Reproduced Saya
Heh, I guess so. I wasn't really conscious of it myself, but now that you mention it, maybe you're right?
Reproduced Saya
No matter the situation, I will live in a way that is not shameful for being the daughter of those people.
Reproduced Saya
I think that is a very difficult and tough thing to do, though...
Reproduced Saya
Well, it's a piece of cake for a genius like me! Besides, I have reliable companions too~
Me
Haha, I suppose so...
Reproduced Saya laughed jokingly, but beneath that expression lay a firm resolve and strong determination.
Reproduced Saya
But setting that aside, tell me about yourself this time.
Reproduced Saya
Do Taimanin always carry out dangerous missions like this one?
Reproduced Saya
And what about a lover? You seemed to get along really well with Asuka and that crane maid...
Reproduced Saya
Could it be that you're dating one of them? ...Heh~
Me
No, I'm not dating anyone... but, well, I'll talk about that in order too.
And so, Reproduced Saya and I spent our time enjoying the hot spring, talking about all sorts of things.
